verdict.rationale: Lago ships its own AI agent and Dunning Agent, so the question of whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair one. However, the pack never documents connecting or plugging in third-party MCP servers for Lago to use. The only MCP evidence covers Lago's own MCP server, which exposes Lago's billing data to outside assistants. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
